# Family Solutions

> We specialize in treating family conflict and estrangement. Keeping your family together and supporting you when families fall apart.

Family Solutions is a therapy practice in West Bloomfield, Michigan. Sherry Wexler, LMSW, and Marcie Israel, MSW, CSW, are the clinicians. The practice offers two care paths: repair and reunite when a relationship can be made safe, and safe distance and coping when contact would not be safe. Operated by Joshua Israel Ventures LLC.

## Care paths

- [Repair and reunite](https://estrangedfamilysolutions.com/repair.html): For estranged family members who want to explore reconnection carefully, and only where it can happen without a return to harm.
- [Safe distance and coping](https://estrangedfamilysolutions.com/distance.html): For people who need to step back when contact would not be safe, and to cope with the grief that follows.

## Practice

- [Home](https://estrangedfamilysolutions.com/): Family Solutions specializes in treating family conflict and estrangement in West Bloomfield, Michigan.
- [About the clinicians](https://estrangedfamilysolutions.com/about.html): Sherry Wexler, LMSW, and Marcie Israel, MSW, CSW, licensed clinical social workers in Michigan.
- [Contact](https://estrangedfamilysolutions.com/contact.html): Send a message to the practice. Not for emergencies; call 911, or call or text 988 in the United States.
- [Privacy note](https://estrangedfamilysolutions.com/privacy.html): What this static website does with an inquiry. Not a consent form for therapy.
